text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A house was set on fire in Hamad Town, Bahrain, but there were no casualties, the interior ministry said.
- Indian associations and individuals in Bahrain launched a fund-raising campaign to help families of four Indians killed in an arson attack on Friday.
- A powerful blast destroyed a car in Manama on Saturday.
- Bahrain leads all other Arab states in terms of its social, economic, health and development programmes, a United Nations report said.
